Hymn Jukebox is a simple big-button player. All content comes from the official websites of Taiwan Gospel Book Room, which owns the copyright. The app does not bundle, download or store any audio, lyrics or scores.

• Number: opens the official mygoodland.video hymn accompaniment page at the hymn you typed. mygoodland.video is a paid subscription service; sign in with your own account to play.

• Previews: plays the free public online previews of TWGBR hymn albums from twgbr.org.tw.

• Phone: plays hymn audio files you already have on your phone. Folders are chosen with the system folder picker, so no storage permission is needed; files are only played on the phone, never uploaded, and no internet is used. The number pad plays your file at once when one matches (turn off "Prefer phone files" under Phone to change this).

• For free full playback by number, use TWGBR's official app.
